messages:
Alice M: CI on main is red after the token rotation. failing jobs: integration-tests/integration-connector (KMS decrypt failure)
Ben S: saw it, trying a rerun now
DevOps Bot: [CI] workflow run failed — job integration-tests (exit 1) — logs: KMS_DECRYPT_ERROR: unable to decrypt ciphertext
Carla R: maybe the GH app lost write access to repo secrets during the swap?
Dan K: before we rerun widely can someone bisect last 4 commits? last green at commit abc123
Alice M: here's the failing log snippet:
```
Error: failed to load secret: KMS: decrypt returned AccessDenied
at src/secrets/loader.rs:42
```
Emily P: @Carla I checked the org audit — there was a completed key rotation at 2026-03-16 02:10 UTC for kms://projects/redwood/keys/ci
Carla R: ok, check vault -> approle role binding to that KMS key. If the CI role lost kms:decrypt permission tests will 404
Ben S: rerun aborted: gha reported 403 on secret retrieval
Ben S: starting a manual rerun of the failing job with --skip-cache
Dan K: also share the commit hash range and I'll run a bisect job locally
Alice M: range: abc123..def456
DevOps Bot: enqueueing rerun request by Ben S — run id 987654321
Emily P: FYI the service principal we use for runners had its key rotated too; I opened an ops-ticket #OPS-432
Carla R: short-term fix: flip CI to fall back to the previous KMS key alias (if ops approves)
Ben S: rerun finished — same error. looks like permission denied, not a transient
Dan K: ok starting bisect: building each commit with test subset
Alice M: if bisect finds the breaking change we can revert, otherwise Ops needs to patch perms
Emily P: pinging infra on pager: @oncall please confirm kms:decrypt for projects/ci-runner
Oncall Bot: paging infra-oncall — paging channel eng-infra-oncall
Infra Pager: got it, checking IAM bindings now
Infra Pager: confirmed the CI runner service account lost kms.decrypt after rotation, re-adding... will take ~15m
Carla R: once binding is back we should restart a single runner and rerun failed job
Infra Pager: binding restored, restarted runner
Ben S: rerun started — fingers crossed :crossed_fingers:
DevOps Bot: run 987654321: job integration-tests — success
Alice M: green! thanks everyone. follow-up: add a test that detects missing KMS perms in CI smoke
Dan K: +1, and a small playbook for key rotations. I'll draft.
Emily P: created OPS-432 with steps, linking here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-432
Alice M: closing thread — will track in OPS-432. :thumbsup:
